name: Top Host
steps: Tap the uniform icon and use it on the left worker.
Tap the next uniform icon and use it on the right worker.
Tap the brick icon and repair the wall.
Tap the flooring icon and upgrade the floor.
Tap the shelving icon and replace the old produce racks.
Tap the refrigerator icon and install new coolers.
Tap the checkout icon and upgrade the counter.
Tap the staff to open the store and complete the level.
